name: intake_and_three_p2_allocation_rules
density_rule: Core density stays 16 kg/m3. Lower density is an NFI direction, not a fourth point.
mass_ceiling: Total counted mass equals lift mass. Residual margin is numerical zero. That is no reserve and no payload.
comparison: Sealed P2-A is the face-only comparison. P1 and P3 rows are not repeated.

points.P2-C: Spend the whole ceiling on core thickness. Face thickness stays 0.0002 m.
points.P2-K: Scale baseline face thickness and core thickness by one factor until the ceiling.
points.P2-E: Split the structural mass budget equally between faces and core, then set each thickness from that mass.

yield_premise.source: Inherited owner snippet of ASM MatWeb 6061-T6 AA typical tensile yield. Direct fetch failed on the prior clock. No compressive yield. Not a certification.

omitted_targets: Phase 2 derives QUESTIONABLE core shear and wrinkling property targets from the pinned advisory formulas. Core crush has no formula in the brief and stays NFI.
